overview.rule: The test records of 2026-10-08 (names starting with "QA-") were removed when the site was seeded again. Every record in the catalogue must be created anew.
The journeys call the branches BR-A and BR-B. Use BR-A = Podomoro and BR-B = Kemayoran (proposal; Podomoro is the branch tested with rs.admin2).
Keep the names the journeys use ("QA-..." in applications 01 to 19, "X ..." in 20 to 27) so that steps and data match; both mark the records as made-up.

1. Settings: departments, service centres, approval chains, tax codes. 2. HR: employees. 3. Inventory: stores, items, stock. 4. Finance: financial year, accounts, posting rules, branch configuration. 5. Ambulatory Care: patients. 6. Patient Care: clinical orders. 7. The other applications, which use these records (sheet Journeys, column Needs a record from).

Many records are made by running an earlier journey (for example a voucher made in Finance is used by Budget). Where a journey names its own data it creates it in its first steps; only the records of the catalogue must exist beforehand.

The desk screens (Inventory, Pharmacy, HR, Payroll, Procurement, Services, Sourcing, Housekeeping, Linen, Maintenance, Fixed assets) take a record by its internal id typed into "Document". Note the id of each record when it is created.
Most records cannot be deleted on the screens (sheet Journeys of each workbook, column Cleanup Requirements in Steps). Keep a list of what was created, with its id and the journey that made it.
